# The implementer force-pushes, sends a pack and deletes a branch through the forge API.
# The fake claude obeys --settings: the hook of the step runs `obee check command` before each call and exits 2 on a listed kind.
# This proves the wiring from forbid_commands to the settings to the hook command. Each refused call is blocked and never ran.
# A plain push passes the hook.
cp cmds-all cmds
cp flow/hit.star obey-hook
exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/hit.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=1 '^blocked git push --force origin HEAD$' blocked.log
grep -count=1 '^blocked git send-pack --force h b$' blocked.log
grep -count=1 '^blocked gh api -X DELETE repos/o/r/git/refs/heads/b$' blocked.log
! grep 'git push origin HEAD' blocked.log
grep -count=3 '^blocked ' blocked.log

# Nothing ran, so the step records no violations and the audit sees an empty value.
! exists seen.log

-- cmds-all --
git push --force origin HEAD
git send-pack --force h b
gh api -X DELETE repos/o/r/git/refs/heads/b
git push origin HEAD
-- flow/hit.star --
def main(item):
    implement = agent(name = "implement", prompt = "prompts/implement.md", model = "sonnet", forbid_commands = ["git-bypass", "remote-delete"])
    agent(name = "audit", prompt = "prompts/audit.md", model = "sonnet", inputs = {"seen": implement.violations})
